Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown

Women Empowerment – Mukkamaar Self-Defence Training

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown conducted a Mukkamaar self-defence and training session at Andhra Education Society, Wadala, as part of its ongoing Women Empowerment initiative.

The session focused on equipping students with basic self-defence skills, confidence and awareness, enabling them to better protect themselves and respond appropriately in situations where their safety may be at risk.

Such initiatives go beyond learning physical techniques—they help young girls develop confidence, courage and a sense of self-reliance.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown remains committed to empowering the younger generation with skills that can make a meaningful difference in their lives.

Empower. Educate. Protect.
Together, We Create Lasting Impact.
